info.title: econAPI
info.description: High-performance quantitative finance microservice supporting derivative pricing, portfolio optimization, and extreme risk analytics.

post.description:
Price European options under generalized BSM with continuous dividend yield q.

Returns analytical price, first-order Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Rho),
higher-order Greeks (Vanna, Volga, Charm, Veta, Color, Speed, Ultima),
no-arbitrage bound checks, and optional numerical finite-difference validation.

Price European options under the Heston stochastic volatility model.

Uses Albrecher et al. (2007) continuous Little Trap characteristic function formulation
with adaptive Gauss-Kronrod quadrature, Feller condition verification, and robust implied volatility.
Calibrate Heston model parameters (v0, kappa, theta, xi, rho) to market option quotes.

Price European or American options via Binomial (CRR / Jarrow-Rudd) or Trinomial Trees.

Supports continuous dividend yield q and early exercise premium extraction.
Price Asian options (Geometric exact Kemna-Vorst or Arithmetic Turnbull-Wakeman approximation).
Price single barrier options (Up/Down, In/Out) via Reiner-Rubinstein analytical formulas with rebate.
Price Cash-or-Nothing and Asset-or-Nothing digital/binary options analytically.
Simulate option pricing via Monte Carlo with Antithetic and Control Variate variance reduction.
Calibrate SVI raw slice parameters with Roger Lee wing bounds and butterfly arbitrage checks.
Verify calendar spread arbitrage across term structure of SVI volatility slices.
Fit 3-factor Nelson-Siegel term structure model with unit auto-detection and fit diagnostics.
Fit 4-factor / 6-parameter Nelson-Siegel-Svensson (NSS) parametric yield curve.
Generate Spot, Instantaneous Forward, Par yield curves, and Discount Factors.
Bootstrap a continuous zero-coupon yield curve from money market deposits, futures, and swaps.
Compute clean/dirty bond price, YTM (Brent root-finder), Macaulay/Modified duration, Convexity, and DV01.
Simulate macro yield curve shock scenarios: parallel, steepener, flattener, and butterfly twist.
Compute Key-Rate Duration (KRD) profile across benchmark curve tenors.
Analytical zero-coupon bond pricing under the Vasicek short-rate model.
Analytical zero-coupon bond pricing under the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross (CIR) square-root diffusion model.
Analytical zero-coupon bond pricing under the 1-Factor Hull-White short-rate model.
Compute Hierarchical Risk Parity weights with covariance shrinkage, constraints, and turnover.
Walk-forward rolling out-of-sample backtest of HRP portfolio allocation.
Compute Mean-Variance portfolio weights (Max Sharpe, Min Variance, Target Return, Target Risk).
Equal Risk Contribution (ERC) portfolio optimization equalizing marginal risk contributions.
Compute Black-Litterman implied equilibrium returns, posterior returns, and posterior covariance.
Rockafellar-Uryasev Linear Programming CVaR / Expected Shortfall portfolio optimization.
Brinson-Fachler performance attribution (allocation, selection, interaction effects).
Compute portfolio risk-adjusted metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Max Drawdown, Ulcer, Tracking Error).

Compute tail-risk VaR and Expected Shortfall via Extreme Value Theory (GPD/POT).

Fits a Generalized Pareto Distribution to tail losses with Kolmogorov-Smirnov goodness of fit,
QQ-plot coordinates, Mean Excess diagnostics, and 95% asymptotic confidence intervals.
Compute VaR and CVaR across Historical, Parametric Normal, Student-t, and Cornish-Fisher models.
Fit GARCH(1,1) conditional volatility model via Quasi-Maximum Likelihood (QMLE).
Compute RiskMetrics EWMA volatility path.
Decompose asset returns into systematic factor exposures and idiosyncratic risk.
Evaluate portfolio P&L under historical and macro stress shock scenarios.
Backtest VaR predictions using Kupiec POF, Christoffersen Independence, and Basel Traffic Light rules.
Fit the Nelson-Siegel parametric yield curve to observed market yields.

get.description: Retrieve historical prices with automated data quality checks (stale prices, outliers, missing values).
Retrieve full listed option chain with bids, asks, open interest, and implied volatility.

post.description:
Calibrate Gatheral's SVI volatility surface model directly on live exchange option chains

and verify Roger Lee wing bounds and Gatheral butterfly arbitrage conditions.

get.description:
Retrieve active US Treasury yield curve from Federal Reserve (FRED)

and calibrate Nelson-Siegel-Svensson term structure with discount factors.

post.description:
Execute point-in-time walk-forward backtest avoiding look-ahead bias

incorporating realistic slippage, transaction friction, and weight drift.
Batch-price up to 500 options concurrently with complete Greeks.
Price an entire bond portfolio and compute aggregated market value, portfolio duration, and total DV01.
